findings.issue: Section `## Reviewers` is missing entirely. After `## Details` (Implementation hints) the file jumps directly to `## Post-completion`. Template requires a `## Reviewers` section in every task (even when reviewers list is empty — must contain explanatory note).

findings.issue: PK paths use `~/.claude/skills/project-knowledge/project.md` (also `architecture.md`, `patterns.md`). Two problems: (a) `~/` does not resolve to the project — `~/.claude/skills/` only contains shared/global skills, not `project-knowledge` (which is project-local at `<repo>/.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/`); (b) missing `references/` segment.
findings.fix: Replace with project-relative paths anchored at the feature folder, mirroring Task 6: `../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md`, `…/references/architecture.md`, `…/references/patterns.md`.

findings.issue: PK paths use `~/.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md` (and architecture.md, patterns.md). The `~/` prefix does not resolve to the project — project-knowledge is project-local. Files at `~/.claude/skills/project-knowledge/` do not exist for this project, so all three PK links are broken.
findings.fix: Replace `~/` with project-relative path: `../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md`, `…/references/architecture.md`, `…/references/patterns.md`. Pattern matches Task 6.

findings.issue: PK paths use only two `..` levels: `../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md` (also architecture.md, deployment.md, patterns.md). From `work/orangetrack-rendering-fixes/tasks/10.md`, `../../` resolves to `work/.claude/...` which does not exist. Three levels are required to reach repo root.
findings.fix: Change `../../` to `../../../` for all four PK file links: `../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md`, `…/references/architecture.md`, `…/references/deployment.md`, `…/references/patterns.md`.
